about: Burning blur into a screenshot (docs/spec/08-privacy-and-security.md). Owner: Rust library/media.rs burn_redactions; the Chrome edition's apps/chrome/src/library/blur.ts must give the same pixels. The image is made from the formula, pixel (x, y) = [(7x + 3y) % 256, (5x + 11y) % 256, (13x + 2y) % 256, 255], blurred with the rects in order; the expected value is the FNV-1a 32-bit hash of the RGBA bytes afterwards.
